description: Import a change set -- a pull/merge request or commit of GitHub, GitLab, or Gitea, given by its URL or by its number `#<number>`, or a diff/patch file -- into the current Git working copy as unstaged and untracked files, merging it with local changes, resolving conflicts semantically, keeping the conflict markers of unresolvable hunks, reporting them as a TODO, and emitting an IMPORTED, CONFLICT, or FAILED verdict. Use when the user calls to "import", "fetch", or "apply" a pull request, merge request, commit, diff, or patch.
